tts.comment: pcm_24000, NEVER mp3. 128kbps MP3 produces coding artifacts on voiced speech that read as static (F12).
tts.comment2: stability was raised to 0.55 and style zeroed while chasing the static, which turned out to be a concat bug (F13) and not the voice at all. The flattened settings were never reverted, and that — not the synthesiser — is why the read went robotic (F30). 0.5 on v3 is its 'natural' preset.
tts.comment3: rate is applied in post with atempo, NOT via ElevenLabs' speed setting — asking v3 for speed 1.15 returned a longer take than 1.0, because run-to-run variance swamps the parameter. atempo is deterministic and pitch-preserving, so pace is a dial rather than a hope.
tts.comment4: 1.18 chosen after hearing 1.26 in a finished video: unadjusted v3 read as 'about to fall asleep on a beach', 1.26 was too fast once cut against the clip. Pace has to be judged in context, not on an isolated sample.

pacing.comment: handoffGap is deliberately short — narration answering the clip immediately reads as a reply rather than a scene change. maxPauseSeconds trims dead air inside the clip the way a human editor would.

overlays.comment: No end card. A subscribe prompt at the tail costs the loop — a short that ends and restarts cleanly gets rewatches, and rewatch is worth more than the handful of subscribes an end card earns.
overlays.comment2: Film burns only at VO<->clip handoffs, never at every cut. The device marks a change of voice, not a change of shot; at 0.76 cuts/sec firing it on each one would be exhausting.
overlays.comment3: Whoosh on every voice change, both directions. The alternative — only on the way into the clip — was tried and rejected: marking every handoff is more consistent, and the burn already fires on all four, so a whoosh on only half of them made the sound and the picture disagree.

audio._: NO MUSIC BED — a standing channel constraint, not an open task. Do not add one, and do not treat its absence as a gap to close. The energy music would carry comes instead from diegetic b-roll ambience, tight pause cutting, and a denser vocal master.
audio.comment2: An accent must sit AT or above the voice for its brief moment or it is not heard at all. The ding source is -22.9 dB RMS and the narration about -23, so the original -8 buried it entirely. +2 reads as an impact without covering the words.

contentStandards._: STANDING CONSTRAINTS, not preferences. These are the channel owner's, and they apply to every asset in every video — stock footage, screenshots, generated imagery, thumbnails. They are not open questions and should never be relitigated or 'balanced' against visual impact.
notes: No music of any kind. Energy comes from diegetic ambience, pause cutting and a dense vocal master (F20).

No alcohol: no bottles, glasses of wine or champagne, bars, or toasting with drinks. Watch for wine glasses dressed into restaurant and dinner-party footage — they are extremely common and easy to miss on a single thumbnail.
No revealing clothing: no low-cut tops, cleavage, or swimwear. Modest dress throughout.
When in doubt, pick a different clip. There is always another clip.
contentStandards.reviewRule: Check EVERY candidate at several timestamps, not one thumbnail. A clip can be clean at 1s and not at 5s — both rejected assets here passed a single-frame glance.
